fn intersperse(numbers: List[Int], delimiter: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(numbers) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == (if (len(numbers) > 0) then ((2 * len(numbers)) - 1) else 0))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not ((i % 2) == 0)) or (result[i] == numbers[(i / 2)]))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not ((i % 2) == 1)) or (result[i] == delimiter))
  effects pure
  example (intersperse([], 0) == [])
